curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where to stop, how to secure the vehicle, how to signal and when to lock it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per step of leaving a vehicle.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about the order of steps when a car must be left on the road.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: List the places where parking is banned and the three different no-parking distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each banned place; a contrast card for the hydrant, crosswalk and railroad distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions that swap the no-parking distances.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain yielding and merging on entry, the solid line and gore area, and signaling and braking on exit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each entry and exit rule; contrast cards for matching speed versus slowing in the deceleration lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about merging and exiting.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Describe highway types, getting into the right lane early, missed exits, and how lanes are used.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each highway rule; contrast cards for missed exits and the busy right lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about lane choice and what to do after missing an exit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define the gore area, then what to do if you need help on a freeway and how to pass a disabled vehicle.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the gore area and daytime versus night signals for help.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about where to stop and how to signal for help.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how HOV lanes are marked, who may use them at posted times, the penalties and crossing the solid line.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each HOV rule; contrast cards for counting the driver and the allowed vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about whether a vehicle may use the HOV lane.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the freeway prohibitions, vehicle readiness, keeping right, lane position and traffic controls.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for shoulder parking and the three-lane highway.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about forbidden freeway moves and lane use.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec08-m01..sec08-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Emergency and prohibited parking, freeway entry and exit, lane use, gore areas, freeway stops, HOV lanes and freeway restrictions
Parking-distance, freeway-merge, gore-area and HOV confusables

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
